notes.title: Bodyguard Task Force — Version 1.0 Release!
notes.content:
After a great run in Early Access, [b]Bodyguard Task Force[/b] is officially launching with [b]Version 1.0[/b]!

Thank you for all your feedback and support. This major update brings new features, polish, and improvements across the board. Here's what's new:

[hr][/hr]


[b]New Firepower[/b]
A full set of [b]new weapons[/b] is now available. Gear up and eliminate threats with style.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906897/a6e834205d0984f4a14aec30b17cddf136dd7eda.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Weapon Progression System[/h1]
Your weapons now [b]level up as you use them[/b], unlocking a variety of [b]attachments[/b] along the way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906897/521e9f9a746ea80d6e30f8d02b8ec6fa959bd32e.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]


[h1]
New Map: Old Town[/h1]
Enter a new combat zone — [b]Old Town[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906897/ccda4034a6b0ca2f35c5a79d1713d90170ec43c0.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

[h1]New Achievements[/h1]
Show your skills and earn [b]three new Steam achievements[/b] by reaching max level with:
[list]
[*]Any [b]Handgun[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906897/68ae04ad5e6116c7fb8bebd3a39951d3fe0d0007.png[/img]
[*]Any [b]SMG[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906897/fd5139f10a18f3938bb6ecc0b0008f44a118b738.png[/img]
[*]Any [b]AR Rifle[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44906897/09268403aa1540e163adf55f465c455c7446f675.png[/img]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

 Other Improvements
[list]
[*] [b]Map Visual Overhaul:[/b] Better lighting and shadows for all maps.
[*] [b]Character Selection:[/b] Choose your bodyguard before missions.
[*] [b]Animation Update:[/b] Leg IK replaced with smoother and more stable animations.
[*] [b]HUD Option:[/b] Toggle the 3D bullet counter on/off.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Thanks again for playing and supporting [b]Bodyguard Task Force[/b]! We're proud to leave Early Access — but this isn’t the end. [b]More content is coming soon.[/b] Stay tuned!
